title: Virtual Compute: immediate refund — paid origin
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute immediate refund — For a primary paid-line cash correction, the target is the most recently issued posted primary charge of the selected holding; the customer must identify that exact line.

Virtual Compute immediate refund — Use the most recent completed posted remittance allocated to the exact selected origin charge; this immediate-refund scope requires one original remittance allocation for that origin.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for immediate refund — paid origin?**

Use the most recent completed posted remittance allocated to the exact selected origin charge; this immediate-refund scope requires one original remittance allocation for that origin.
